title: The relative Frobenius is a universal homeomorphism, integral, and purely inseparable on residue fields
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The proof factors F_X = h  circ  F_{X/S} with h the base change of F_S, observes both F_X and h are universal homeomorphisms by the absolute Frobenius lemma, and concludes universal homeomorphism by permanence, then the integrality and purely inseparable residue field statements by two further Morphisms lemmas. H2: a three-lemma composition whose load-bearing identity h  circ  F_{X/S} = F_X and the correct application of permanence are the content.
